WFHSS SterilPrint

Every choice shapes tomorrow.
Every action protects life.

Every reprocessing cycle consumes energy and water and emits CO₂. This tool helps CSSD managers measure that impact — and identify what they can change today, at zero cost.

⚠ Pilot v1.2 — Belgrade 2026. Results for decision support and professional learning only. ISO 14044 §4.2.3.3.
🎯
Purpose
Evidence-based environmental decisions for CSSD managers worldwide. Not for regulatory compliance — for operational awareness and professional learning.
🔬
Methodology
ISO 14067:2018 carbon footprint · ISO 14044:2006 principles · Gate-to-gate · Functional unit: one complete reprocessing cycle · EF: IEA 2026 + national authorities
📊
Two output units
① kg CO₂e / cycle — comparable across all WFHSS countries · ② kg CO₂e / set — internal use only · France 🇫🇷: CO₂e / Unité d'Oeuvre (SF2S barème)
🌐
5 global clusters
57 WFHSS member countries in 5 clusters by electricity emission intensity. Physical inventory (kWh, L) always directly comparable across all clusters.
Why CO₂e differs between countries — and why that is NOT inefficiency
The electricity emission factor varies up to 47× between WFHSS member countries (Norway 0.017 → Indonesia 0.760 kg CO₂e/kWh). The same autoclave consuming 15 kWh produces very different CO₂e depending on the national grid. Physical inventory (kWh, L) is always directly comparable.

CLUSTER E
High variability
China · USA · India · Russia
A CSSD in Cluster E with identical equipment and identical efficiency to Cluster A produces 15–40× more kg CO₂e per kWh consumed. This is a grid fact, not a performance gap. Physical inventory (kWh, litres) is always directly comparable.

✓ Can change — zero cost
  • Autoclave load → validated max (S2)
  • Sterile set FIFO rotation (ST1)
  • Detergent dose within IFU range (W1)
  • Bowie-Dick frequency documentation
~ Can influence — future
  • WD model at next equipment purchase (W3)
  • Autoclave technology generation (S3)
  • Packaging type — if using flexible (P1)
  • Consumable supplier country of origin
ℹ Context — cannot change
  • National electricity grid EF
  • Sterilization cycle policy (R1)
  • Hospital infrastructure
